preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(S, str) and len(S) == N and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in S) for S, N in zip(S_list, N_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, S is a string of length N containing only lowercase English letters.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines per test case.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[2*i] == 'NO' and stdout_lines[2*i+1] == '') or (stdout_lines[2*i] == 'YES' and stdout_lines[2*i+1].isdigit()) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'NO' followed by an empty line, or 'YES' followed by a non-negative integer representing the minimum operations.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[2*i] == 'NO') == (sum(1 for c in S_list[i] if S_list[i].count(c) % 2 != 1) > 1) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: A test case outputs 'NO' if and only if the string S cannot form a palindrome (i.e., more than one character has an odd count).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[2*i] == 'YES') == (sum(1 for c in S_list[i] if S_list[i].count(c) % 2 != 1) <= 1) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: A test case outputs 'YES' if and only if the string S can form a palindrome (i.e., at most one character has an odd count).

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[2*i+1]) == min_ops_to_palindrome(S_list[i]) if stdout_lines[2*i] == 'YES' else 0 for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the integer is the minimum number of adjacent swaps required to transform S into a palindrome, where each swap involves two adjacent characters and neither character can be reused in another swap.
